release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.7.2: Obsidian Minimalist Bento Grid Architecture & Mobile Engine Hardening.
• Complete App-Wide Unslopping: Standardized all 32 student and parent screens onto high-contrast Obsidian Minimalist Bento Grid design system.
• Sensory Feedback: Integrated centralized tactile haptics engine across all gestures, slider limits, toggles, and modal interactions.
• Type-Safe Deep Routing: Hardened notification routing engine with runtime destination validation and tap deduplication.
• Non-blocking Guardian Confirmations & Accessible Touch Targets: Expanded touch bounds to 44dp minimum and eliminated blocking modal alerts.
